exchange_family: Every nonempty connected edge support S of size at most k that is U-closed for the old frame. Endpoints retain all fixed colors and U components outside S, allow arbitrary D/U and A colors inside S, and are U-closed on the new side. Every old mu-attaining phase is tested; outside full colors are frozen to that phase. No single-entry interpolation assumption.
canonicalization: Vertex/edge labels fixed. Only global A-color names are normalized by restricted growth; 0 is retained, B phases are all listed. Raw A-orbit size is 4!/(4-q)!.
known_control_origin: C25 graph on eight vertices, but the new word is not the C24 singleton or C25 fork word. No previous enumeration result is accepted as a replay receipt.
